tasks.label: Dev: Maybe build API image
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $timeoutSeconds = 3; Write-Host "Build API image before debug? [y/N] Default: N in $timeoutSeconds seconds"; $choice = $null; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($timeoutSeconds); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and $null -eq $choice) { try { if ([Console]::KeyAvailable) { $choice = [Console]::ReadKey($true).KeyChar } } catch { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; if ($choice -eq 'y' -or $choice -eq 'Y') { docker-compose build xarchiver } else { Write-Host 'Skipping API image build.' }

windows.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $timeoutSeconds = 3; Write-Host "Build API image before debug? [y/N] Default: N in $timeoutSeconds seconds"; $choice = $null; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($timeoutSeconds); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and $null -eq $choice) { try { if ([Console]::KeyAvailable) { $choice = [Console]::ReadKey($true).KeyChar } } catch { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; if ($choice -eq 'y' -or $choice -eq 'Y') { docker-compose build xarchiver } else { Write-Host 'Skipping API image build.' }

osx.command: bash -lc 'echo "Build API image before debug? [y/N] Default: N in 3 seconds"; if read -r -n 1 -t 3 choice; then echo; else choice=""; echo; fi; case "$choice" in y|Y) docker-compose build xarchiver ;; *) echo "Skipping API image build." ;; esac'

tasks.command: docker-compose run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:18000:8000 -p 127.0.0.1:5678:5678 --entrypoint python xarchiver -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:5678 -m xarchiver.cli serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
